instructions.title: Payment Instructions
instructions.step1: Click "Proceed to Checkout" to go to Paymob's secure payment page
instructions.step2: Choose your payment method (cards, wallets, Valu, etc.)
instructions.step3: Enter your payment details and complete 3D Secure (OTP) if required
instructions.step4: After successful payment, you'll be redirected back to our site
instructions.step5: Your tokens will be added automatically to your account
